description.p: Recompilations and decompilations are native PC versions of console games, rebuilt by their developers from the original game. RecompLauncher finds, installs, updates and starts them, straight from each developer's own GitHub release.

ul.li: Discover every project, with what it needs and how it runs for other players
Install and update in one click, with every download checked against GitHub's checksum
Easy Setup: point it at your disc image or game folder and it does the rest
Save backups before every update, and optional cloud saves
Big Picture mode for a controller and a TV

description.p: No game files are included: every game needs your own copy, which you choose the first time you set it up.

screenshot.caption: Featured projects and games ready to play

description.p: Bring Your Games for moving over from another launcher, self-updates on a Mac, and Big Picture fixes.
A Coming Soon page with recomp requests, Keep Steam in Sync, Sync Now for cloud saves, shared game media across versions, and a smoother Downloads graph.
A window that opens once drawn, a clearer tray icon, smoother Big Picture on Steam Deck, and crash reports on GitHub.
No more false Offline mark, smarter cloud save uploads, and fixes.
Save sharing between versions of a game, a Run in background setting, drag to reorder pinned games, cleaner game and Achievements pages, and fixes.
NVIDIA DLSS for recomps that ask for it, saved games that sync between PCs, proxy support, and fixes.
New versions show up when RecompLauncher opens, smoother updates and more accurate play time.
Safer launcher updates, plus improvements and fixes.
A redesigned Downloads page, plus improvements and fixes.
